name: How long does a typical whole-home renovation project take with Opus Builders?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical whole-home renovation project take with Opus Builders?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a whole-home renovation varies significantly based on the project's scope, the home's size, the complexity of structural changes, and the finishes selected. Generally, a comprehensive luxury whole-home renovation can take anywhere from 8 to 24 months from initial design to final completion. This includes phases for architectural design, permitting, material selection, demolition, construction, and finishing work. We provide a detailed project schedule early in the process to set clear expectations and keep you informed every step of the way.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines vary, but a luxury whole-home renovation typically takes 8 to 24 months, encompassing design, permitting, construction, and finishing. We provide a detailed schedule.
